title: Amazfit GTR
symptom: Users request Amazfit GTR syncing with xDrip so glucose/BG values can appear on the watch; activating the Amazfit Service does not show anything on the watch, and no official GTR watchface/plugin is available.
cause: No Amazfit GTR plugin/support has been implemented in the NightscoutFoundation xDrip repo; only Amazfit Pace/Stratos were compatible for graph watchfaces at the time, and the GTR/GTS line is otherwise unsupported.
fix: A user-reported workaround was to pair the GTR through xDrip's Mi Band menu by entering the watch's Bluetooth MAC, restarting the watch, and then installing a custom GTR watchface (built from external instructions/tools, e.g. Artem/bigdigital's xDrip-miband and Patreon posts) to receive BG notifications. The GTR 42 also requires a 42mm watchface.
evidence_quote: I got connection GTR and xdrip via miband menu. Put MAC of my GTR and restarted watch.
